SQLite documents distinct durability guarantees for synchronous modes; application crash, OS crash and power loss are not interchangeable evidence classes.

novel_concepts.name: Admission Horizon
novel_concepts.definition: The latest transition for which a receipt still binds all executable bytes and authority-relevant state; beyond it the receipt is historical evidence, not current permission.

novel_concepts.name: Crash-Class Type System
novel_concepts.definition: A promotion discipline in which process crash, OS crash, power loss, logical rollback, projection rebuild and boot receipts have distinct non-coercible types.

novel_concepts.name: Semantic Checkpoint Passport
novel_concepts.definition: The conjunctive identity of semantic producer policy, manifest, root, lineage selection, rollback floor and installed boot subject.

novel_concepts.name: Nonce Crown
novel_concepts.definition: The confused-authority error of treating possession of anti-replay material as proof of the human decision it was meant only to correlate.

novel_concepts.name: Negative-Space Compiler Oracle
novel_concepts.definition: A bound suite of programs that must be rejected before host-language coercion, evaluation order or code generation can invent Clay semantics.

novel_concepts.name: Projection Echo Ledger
novel_concepts.definition: An authoritative mutation log whose derived-store application identities are idempotent echoes; acknowledgements are advisory and never become semantic truth.
